environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet, fronted by an internal ALB with a simple TCP health-check listener. The ALB has no WAF WebACL attached. The PostgreSQL RDS instance uses the default parameter group (pg15) with standard_conforming_strings=on but no additional query restrictions. The DB user ('app_svc') has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on all tables in the 'public' schema. Network: ALB SG allows inbound from VPC CIDR on port 443, task SG allows inbound from ALB SG on port 3000, RDS SG allows inbound from task SG on port 5432.

config.db_user_grants: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public
